notes: Seed URL https://www.guadalupetx.gov/ links /page/elections.home and 'Elections Results History'. Guadalupe's Clarity elections.json exists but its newest listing is 2014 and the county pages carry no Clarity link, so check 1 has nothing to read. The Elections Results History page lists only official, post-canvass PDFs for the target elections: 'Guadalupe County General Election - Official Results' and '...pct by pct - Official Results' (2024), 'Republican/Democratic Primary Official Results' (2026 primary), 'Joint Primary Runoff Election-Election Summary Report-Official Results' (2026 runoff); the May 26, 2026 runoff election page lists notices, rosters and ballot logs but no results. No election-night report remains, so check 2 cannot show what was public on election night. One web search found no county election-night results page (only news coverage, which is not evidence). Check 3 pending for all three elections (origin/wayback-data not present). Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-C): no election changed. Tried: (1) Elections Results History page re-read: every 2024 general, 2026 primary and 2026 runoff file is titled Official (for example /upload/page/0210/docs/2026/5-26/Official_Result-052626.pdf); no unofficial or election-night file is listed. (2) The 2026 primary election page folder /upload/page/0358/docs/030326/ (found by search; holds notices and early-vote rosters) returns 404 as a folder; no results file name from it was found. (3) archive.today timemaps for guadalupetx.gov election pages: refused by the fetch module (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable); the Wayback harvest for guadalupetx.gov also failed (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). (4) Check 4: two web searches (county unofficial 2026 results; Seguin Gazette precinct results) found only official county files and Community Impact county-total stories, no third-party per-precinct numbers. Sweep pending. Targeted pass 4 2026-10-02 (targeted4-D): no election changed. Tried: (1) newtools.cira.state.tx.us copies of /upload/page/0210/docs/2024/11-5-24-GC_General-PrctbyPrct.pdf and /upload/page/0210/docs/2026/5-26/Official_Result-052626.pdf: HTTP 404 (the site runs on ezTask Titanium, not the CIRA host; the orchestrator's /page/guadalupe.elections.history was 403), so no state-hosted copies. (2) Election pages elections.election1 to election5 re-read: each has an 'Election Day Results' block that is emptied after the election (the May 26, 2026 runoff page keeps only the commented-out heading 'Election Day Results - May 26, 2026 Primary Runoff Elections'); the April 4, 2026 page still lists 'Unofficial Results - Early Voting Absentee & Election Day' under /upload/page/0443/docs/040426/, showing where such files go, but no target-election file name was found; two pattern names under /upload/page/0358/docs/030326/ returned 404. (3) Leads only (third-party, county totals, not evidence): Community Impact 'UPDATE: Ott wins Guadalupe County Precinct 1 commissioner race' (datePublished 2024-11-06T02:07:35Z) links the county's election-night file https://www.co.guadalupe.tx.us/elections/ElectionPrep/2024/11/5/EV_Unofficial.pdf ('Posted 8:05 p.m. Nov. 5 ... As of 6:58 p.m., Ott has 12,524 votes'); that file and folder now return HTTP 404 on co.guadalupe.tx.us, web.guadalupetx.gov, www.guadalupetx.gov and newtools. Community Impact 'Ronnie Clark wins Guadalupe County Precinct 2 commissioner race' (2026 primary, links https://www.guadalupetx.gov/page/elections.election3): 'Updated 9:07 p.m. Guadalupe County has begun releasing election day results. With 5 of 36 voter precincts reporting, Ronnie Clark still leads with 1,088 votes'. These show county totals were released in updates on election night, but no county file with a printed or upload time survives, and nothing shows whether precinct numbers were posted, so all three stay UNDETERMINED. (4) Check 4: no third-party page with per-precinct candidate votes found (6 web searches). Wayback harvest for guadalupetx.gov failed (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable); no targeted archive or sweep folder for Guadalupe (sweep pending).
